    Convert Unicode Text to Lowercase

    to_lower_unicode.Rd

    Transforms all uppercase characters in a character vector to their lowercase equivalents using an internal Unicode Character Database (UCD) lookup table.

    Usage

    to_lower_unicode(x)

    Arguments

    x

    A character vector to be converted to lowercase.

    Value

    A character vector of the same length as x with all characters converted to lowercase.

    Details

    Unlike base R's tolower(), which can depend on system locale settings and may vary across operating systems, to_lower_unicode() relies on a static, precomputed 1-to-1 Unicode mapping table. This guarantees deterministic, fast, and reproducible lowercase conversion across all platforms (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, etc.).

    Missing values (NA) and empty strings ("") are preserved as-is.

    See also

    remove_diacritics()

    Examples

    # Basic Latin conversion
to_lower_unicode(c("HELLO WORLD", "R Package", "DATA"))
#> [1] "hello world" "r package"   "data"       

# Accented and non-Latin characters (Greek, Cyrillic)
to_lower_unicode(c("ÉLÉPHANT", "ΑΘΉΝΑ", "МОСКВА"))
#> [1] "éléphant" "αθήνα"    "москва"  

# Preserves empty strings and NA values
to_lower_unicode(c("MIXED Case", "", NA_character_))
#> [1] "mixed case" ""           NA
